title: Epic Creator Output
description: Output schema for the epic creator agent. Converts an approved roadmap and vision into a grounded, deduplicated set of epics with full traceability.

execution_summary.description: Plain-text summary: epic count, roadmap coverage, dedupe results, grouping decisions, reflection findings

epics.description: Business capability epics, grounded and deduplicated, ordered by dependency

open_questions.description: Plain-language unresolved items — unmappable roadmap items, ambiguous grounding, unresolved dedupe matches

delivery_summary.description: Plain-text summary of the epic set and phase allocation

Epic.description: A business capability epic. Must represent a business capability, NOT a technical layer.

title.description: Business capability title, <=10 words, verb-first — not a technical layer

description.description: What this epic delivers and why, grounded in roadmap/vision content

business_value.description: Must cite a specific vision value theme, not a generic statement

priority.description: MoSCoW priority, derived from roadmap ordering

target_phase.description: Roadmap phase/quarter this epic belongs to

checked.description: Must be true on every execution, regardless of suspected overlap

matches.description: Existing tracker epic IDs found to be potential duplicates/overlaps

confidence.description: 0.9+ for epics directly grounded in explicit roadmap/vision content. 0.7-0.9 for inferred groupings.

reasoning.description: Why this epic exists, why this scope, why this priority
